meta.title: 被问凭什么胜任这份工作：四步回答法
meta.title_en: Why Are You the Right Fit? A Four-Step Answer

scenes.title_cn: 压力题：回答不好影响定级
scenes.title_en: A high-pressure question that affects your outcome
scenes.context: 讲者点出这是压力题，回答不好会直接影响面试结果和定级水平。
sentences: 你为什么觉得能胜任这份工作？这是一个压力题，回答不好会直接影响你的面试结果和定级水平。
"Why are you the right fit for this job?" It's a pressure question — a weak answer directly hurts your outcome and your leveling.
定级水平：your leveling / grade
这个问题回答不好会直接影响你的面试结果，非常关键，我们一定要把握好。
Getting it wrong can sink the whole interview, so it's critical to get it right.
把握好：get it right
可以参考下面这个思路方向去回答。
Here's a structure you can follow.
思路方向：a structure / line of thinking
paraphrase: 胜任力题=压力题→答不好代价大
It's a pressure question with real stakes.
答题要有结构→不是临场瞎说
Answer it with a structure, not on the fly.
scenes.speak: "Why are you the right fit for this job?" It's a pressure question — a weak answer directly hurts your outcome and your leveling. Getting it wrong can sink the whole interview, so it's critical to get it right. Here's a structure you can follow.

scenes.context: 讲者给出四步回答框架：观点、理由、案例、重申。
sentences: 先表明观点，再说理由。
First, state your position; then give your reasons.
表明观点：state your position
第三步补充充足的案例。
Third, back it up with concrete examples.
补充案例：back it up with examples
最后再重申你的观点。
Finally, restate your point to close the loop.
重申观点：restate your point
paraphrase: 四步=论点-论据-案例-回扣
Four steps: claim, reasons, evidence, restatement.
框架让论证闭环→说服力更强
The loop makes your argument convincing.
scenes.speak: First, state your position; then give your reasons. Third, back it up with concrete examples. Finally, restate your point to close the loop.

scenes.title_en: A demo: let the numbers talk
scenes.context: 讲者给出完整示范，用经验年限和营收数字证明匹配度。
sentences: 我觉得自己和咱们公司在招的这个岗位非常匹配，我很适合这份工作。
I believe I'm a great match for this role and a strong fit for the position.
非常匹配：a great match
我大概有8年B端产品运营经验，累计完成合同金额超过4000万。
I have about eight years of B2B product operations experience, with contracts totaling over 40 million.
合同金额：contract value
实际营收突破1000万，我相信自己一定能胜任这份工作，并且拿到很好的结果。
Actual revenue exceeded 10 million, and I'm confident I can deliver great results in this role.
营收突破：revenue exceeded
paraphrase: 观点→理由→数据→承诺的完整示范
The demo runs the whole loop: claim, reason, data, promise.
scenes.speak: I believe I'm a great match for this role and a strong fit for the position. I have about eight years of B2B product operations experience, with contracts totaling over 40 million. Actual revenue exceeded 10 million, and I'm confident I can deliver great results in this role.

practice: I believe I'm a strong fit for this role.
Last year I drove contracts worth over 40 million.
My B2B operations background is exactly what this role needs.
I'm confident I can deliver strong results here.
pitfalls: ✕ 直译腔：I think I can do this job well.
✓ 地道说法：I'm confident I can deliver strong results in this role.
deliver results 比 do the job well 更有职场质感。
✕ 直译腔：My ability is very strong.
✓ 地道说法：My track record shows consistent, measurable outcomes.
用 track record 代替抽象的能力自夸。
✕ 直译腔：I completed contract amount 40 million.
✓ 地道说法：I closed contracts totaling over 40 million.
contracts totaling 是描述合同金额的地道表达。
✕ 直译腔：I will restate my viewpoint again.
✓ 地道说法：Let me close by restating my point.
close by restating 表达收尾重申。
shifts: 被问胜任就现场临场发挥
用四步框架提前准备逐字稿
用形容词证明自己很强
用可量化的业绩数字证明匹配
观点-理由-案例-重申闭环收尾
footer_notes: ASR 校正说明：「内视结果」校正为「面试结果」，「和定性水平」校正为「和定级水平」，「重工的案例」校正为「充足的案例」，「QB产品运营」校正为「B端产品运营」，「在生态产品运营」按语境保留「生态产品运营」，「财富1%」校正为「约40%」，「我是Eason」按语境处理为口播者的自我介绍。场景/句子朗读使用 edge-tts，单词发音使用浏览器 Web Speech API。
